name: Weighted Lying Neck Flexion (Neck Harness)
how_to:
1. Set Up Your Equipment:
  - Use a neck harness designed for weightlifting. Securely attach a small weight plate to the harness chain.
  - Ensure the harness fits snugly around your head without causing discomfort.
2. Prepare the Bench:
  - Position a workout bench at a 45-degree incline.
  - Sit on the bench and lean back so your upper back is supported while your head extends beyond the edge of the bench.
3. Starting Position:
  - Place the neck harness on your head, ensuring it is centered.
  - Let your head hang slightly back in a neutral position.
4. Execute the Movement:
  - Flex your neck forward, bringing your chin toward your chest in a slow and controlled motion.
  - Pause briefly at the top of the movement to fully contract the neck muscles.
  - Slowly return your head to the starting position, resisting the weight as you lower.
5. Repetitions:
  - Perform 2–4 sets of 8–15 repetitions depending on your fitness level and goals.
